asm.name: task:uart-string:solution
asm.source:
li   t0, 0x10000000   # UART
  la   t1, msg          # указатель на строку

  lbu  t2, 0(t1)
  beqz t2, конец        # нулевой байт — конец строки
  sb   t2, 0(t0)
  addi t1, t1, 1
  j    цикл

  ebreak

.data

asm.name: task:factorial:solution
asm.source:
li   a0, 6
  call fact
  ebreak

fact:
  addi sp, sp, -16
  sw   ra, 12(sp)       # адрес возврата — на стек
  sw   s0, 8(sp)
  mv   s0, a0           # n запоминаем в s0
  li   t0, 2
  blt  s0, t0, база     # n < 2 — вернуть 1
  addi a0, s0, -1
  call fact             # fact(n-1)

  li   s0, 1             # счётчик

  beqz t0, say_fizzbuzz
  rem  t0, s0, s2
  beqz t0, say_fizz
  rem  t0, s0, s3
  beqz t0, say_buzz
  mv   a0, s0
  call print_int
  j    next
say_fizzbuzz:

  li   a2, 9
  j    say

  li   a2, 5
  j    say

  la   a1, buzz
  li   a2, 5

  li   a0, 1
  li   a7, 64
  ecall
next:
  addi s0, s0, 1
  blt  s0, s1, loop
  li   a0, 0
  li   a7, 93            # exit(0)
  ecall

# print_int(a0): печатает знаковое число и перевод строки.

  srai t3, t2, 31        # t3 = -1 у отрицательного числа, иначе 0
  xor  t2, t2, t3
  sub  t2, t2, t3        # t2 = модуль числа

  sb   t4, 0(t0)

  addi t0, t0, -1
  li   t4, '-'
  sb   t4, 0(t0)
print_int_out:
  li   a0, 1             # fd = 1: стандартный вывод
  mv   a1, t0            # адрес первого символа
  addi a2, sp, 32
  sub  a2, a2, t0        # длина
  li   a7, 64            # write
  ecall
  addi sp, sp, 32
  ret

  addi s1, s1, -1
  blez s1, print
  li   t1, 0             # i

  call print_int

files.content:
# Build a RISC-V program (32-bit, RV32IM instructions) with plain clang + lld.
CLANG ?= clang
FLAGS  = --target=riscv32 -march=rv32im -mabi=ilp32 -nostdlib -static -fuse-ld=lld

program: program.s
	$(CLANG) $(FLAGS) -o program program.s

# run it in the qemu emulator (user-mode emulation)
run: program
	qemu-riscv32 ./program; echo "exit code: $$?"

# see which 32-bit words you got (compare with the listing on the site)
dump: program
	llvm-objdump -d program

clean:
	rm -f program
files.name: Makefile

files.content:
# RISC-V program

The file program.s is your RISC-V assembly program (what you wrote on the site).
The entry point is the _start label. Output is the write system call (a7 = 64),
exit is the exit call (a7 = 93), as in Linux.

## What to install

macOS:
  brew install llvm lld qemu
  export PATH="$(brew --prefix llvm)/bin:$(brew --prefix lld)/bin:$PATH"

Ubuntu / Debian:
  sudo apt install clang lld llvm qemu-user

## Build and run

  make run     # build and run; shows the exit code at the end
  make dump    # disassemble: see the real 32-bit words
  make clean

If you have the GNU toolchain (riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc), build like this:
  riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc -march=rv32im -mabi=ilp32 -nostdlib -static -o program program.s
  qemu-riscv32 ./program
